description: Renders one HTML invoice, with a line for each item and their total, from a JSON object a program supplies.
guide:
This package renders invoice.html, an HTML page that prints one invoice:
its number and the date it was issued, the seller and the buyer, a table
of the items invoiced with each line's amount, the total, and optional
notes. The page carries class names and no style of its own.

It is written for a program, not a person. A billing job reads the
invoice from wherever it is kept, writes it as invoice.json in a data
directory, and runs two commands:

    metais validate invoice --data data
    metais render invoice --data data --out out

validate reports every value that does not fit the
[invoice schema](inputs/invoice.schema.json), and render writes
out/invoice.html. Every value is HTML-escaped, so a name, an address, a
description or a note may hold any text.

Each line's amount is its quantity times its unit price, and the total is
the sum of the amounts; the program supplies neither. Every amount is in
the invoice's one currency, given as its three-letter ISO 4217 code.
Leave notes out when there is nothing to add.

inputs.description: One invoice, as the billing program that issues it holds it.
